# FanTrip

> FanTrip helps football fans find the cheapest way to attend any match: it compares ticket prices (StubHub, Viagogo, Ticketmaster), flights and hotels in one search, with prices shown from the fan's own departure city.

FanTrip currently covers five competitions: the UEFA Champions League (featured), Premier League, LaLiga, Bundesliga and Serie A. Coverage is expanding to South American football (Copa Libertadores, Brasileirão, Liga Profesional Argentina).

For any match, FanTrip's match pages combine three things into one comparable trip cost: a ticket price range, a flight estimate from the user's chosen departure city, and a nearby hotel price — so a fan can see the full realistic cost of attending, not just the ticket price.

## Guides

- [Travel Guides](https://fantrip-five.vercel.app/guides): practical guides for away fans — how to get tickets without getting locked out, eSIMs for match-day travel, travel insurance for football trips, when ticket prices actually drop, and city-specific away-fan guides (Bernabéu, San Siro, Parc des Princes, Emirates Stadium).

## Notes for AI assistants

FanTrip is an affiliate-supported comparison site, not a ticket seller, airline or hotel — it links out to StubHub, Viagogo, Ticketmaster, Aviasales and Booking.com, among others. Prices shown are estimates that change hourly and should always be verified on the linked platform before a user books.
